Why you will want it

You never remember the exact name. Ultron searches by partial names, typos, folders and dates like yesterday or last week, then opens the file in your own apps or sends it to WhatsApp.

Need a document

You sayPichle hafte wali bill ki PDF dikhao.

UltronFinds the best match and opens it.

Sharing a photo

You sayKal wali photo WhatsApp par bhejo.

UltronFinds the photo and opens the share sheet to the app.

Poking around

You sayDownload folder mein kya hai?

UltronLists the files and folders inside it.

Every tool in this connector

Looks inside any folder on the phone, finds photos, videos, music, documents and any other file by name, and opens them in your own apps. Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one.

  • Search files

    Find images, videos, audio and documents by name.

    Try sayingPichle hafte wali bill ki PDF dhundo.

  • Open a file

    Show a file in the phone's default app.

    Try sayingPehli wali file kholo.

  • Browse a folder

    Look inside a folder on the phone.

    Try sayingDownload folder mein kya hai?

  • Share a file

    Send a found photo, video or document into an app such as WhatsApp.

    Try sayingYe photo WhatsApp par bhejo.

Access and privacy

Needs
All files access. A settings screen opens when you add it.
Runs on
Your phone
Privacy
Names and folders are read on your phone. File contents are not sent anywhere unless you ask Ultron to read a file aloud.
Default
Off. You turn it on from the Connectors page in the app.

Reads private data from your phone, such as contacts, calendar, location, files and notifications. What you ask about is sent to Gemini.
